verdict.rationale: Brevo publishes a documented public developer API on developers.brevo.com. It covers transactional email, SMS/WhatsApp, contacts, ecommerce, conversations and events, with API key and OAuth 2.0 M2M auth, official SDKs, a Postman workspace, and per-endpoint reference docs. Agent-oriented aids include llms.txt and Markdown versions of pages (both confirmed by probe) plus an MCP integration. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of using the API in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Import, update, and organize your contact lists programmatically.
Authenticate with an API key, or with OAuth 2.0 — including machine-to-machine (M2M) for server-to-server integrations.
Official SDKs with full API coverage. Available for Node.js, Python, and PHP.
Explore and test API endpoints with our pre-configured Postman workspace.
For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
